protocol.type: custom streaming protocol (NOT the standard-suite; not comparable to strata-bench numbers)
protocol.workload: 3 Korean prompt types cycling 2:2:1 — arithmetic+parity (two varying operands), 3-line summary of a ~1.5K-char pasted document, numbered-extraction over a ~15.6K-char pasted pseudo-log; ~60 / ~900 / ~8,700 prompt tokens; max_tokens 200/350/250; temperature 0.3; thinking ON; verbatim text in prompts.md
protocol.timing: client-side SSE: TTFT = first non-empty delta (may be reasoning token), keep-alives/empty deltas ignored; decode tok/s = tokens/(t_last - t_first); tokens = non-empty content+reasoning chunks

endurance_long_prompt_request.note: engine 'generated in' line for the 8.6K-token prompt in the K=32 window vs client long-arm median; exact line-to-request attribution beyond boot-window was not preserved

protocol.calibration_note: engine-reported tok/s runs ~0-1% below client on short prompts and ~15% below on 8.6K-prompt requests; absolute decode magnitudes carry that slop, cross-arm deltas share one method on one binary in one afternoon
protocol.arms: systemd restart per arm then 240 s sequential mixed-size streaming, K=20,24,26,28,30,32 back-to-back 15:02-15:37 UTC; restart between arms, profile file preserved, conversation cache empty, unique per-request tags (no prefix reuse)
protocol.endurance: 600 s sequential + 90 s x 4 concurrent + 1 recovery request; baseline run same protocol at K=20 14:25 UTC
protocol.background: the agent operating this box shares the server during ALL runs (a few long-context gateway turns); equal across arms; disclosed
